name: menhir-ui
description: Obelisk Menhir web UI (vanilla JS + nostr-tools, bundled with esbuild)

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const v=require('./package.json').version;fs.writeFileSync('src/version.js','// generated by npm run build\\nexport const APP_VERSION = '+JSON.stringify(v)+';\\n')" && esbuild src/main.js --bundle --format=iife --minify --outfile=dist/bundle.js && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.copyFileSync('src/index.html','dist/index.html');fs.copyFileSync('src/styles.css','dist/styles.css')"
